cover.title: Your 6-month plan to get found, get chosen and grow sales.
cover.sub: Website, SEO, ads, social media, content, graphics and video, handled by one team, with results you can measure every month.

overview.title: Why this plan, and why now
letter: Dear business owner, most businesses don't struggle online because of a bad product. They struggle because the right customers never find them, or find them and leave without buying.

This proposal shows how we'll fix that over six months. Month one builds the foundation: a fast website, your Google Business Profile, your social pages, and tracking that shows where every sale comes from.
From month two, we put that foundation to work with SEO, content, social media and paid ads. We move budget to whatever brings you customers, and stop what doesn't.
You'll always know what we did and what it brought in. Every month you get a plain-language report on rankings, visitors, leads and sales.

company.title: Who we are
body: Jarz Digital is a full-service digital growth agency. We build websites, rank businesses on Google, run their ads and manage their online presence from one place. Founded in Dallas, we now work from four offices and serve clients in the USA, Canada, the UK and Bangladesh.

The company is led by Roknuzzaman Jony, a computer engineer and Local SEO specialist with more than 10 years of hands-on work. Our SEO is done 100% by hand, every service includes free graphics and SEO-ready content, and we measure our work by calls, orders and revenue.

market.title: The Bangladesh opportunity, in numbers
market.intro: Bangladesh has one of the fastest-growing online markets in Asia. Most customers are on their phones, on Facebook, and still only partly reached by local businesses.
market.plat_h: Where your customers are (ad reach, millions)
ecom: DHL Express projection, 17.7% growth a year
market.cost_src: Sources: KuiperZ (2025), Digitafy (2026), Arafat Labs (2026) for Bangladesh; 7SEA / Triple Whale and Superads (2026) for the USA. 1 USD ≈ Tk 122.7.
market.insights_h: What this means for your business
insights: Facebook builds reach and trust. Google captures people who are ready to buy right now.
TikTok and YouTube together reach 90M+ ad audiences. Short videos are no longer optional.
Reviews, real photos, WhatsApp and cash on delivery turn visitors into buyers in Bangladesh.
Google's AI answers cut clicks to normal results by up to 58% (Ahrefs, 2026). We optimize for AI answers too.
Ad costs rise in Eid, Ramadan and sale seasons. We plan budget and content ahead of them.
Only 44.5% of people are online today. Businesses that build their presence now will own their category later.

profit.chart_h: Monthly sales grow as ads improve and SEO kicks in
profit.scen_h: Works for every business size (Month 6, $750 ad budget)
profit.note: This is an example to show how the numbers work, not a promise. Real results depend on your product, price, margin and market. Small-order businesses make most of their profit from repeat customers, so we build reminder ads and follow-ups into the plan. In Month 2 profit can be small or negative because we are still testing. That is normal: we test first, then scale.
profit.why: Why we can do better than average: international-standard creatives, accurate tracking from day one, and weekly testing. Market averages for Meta e-commerce ads are about 1.9–2.2x return; well-run accounts reach 3.5–5x (Triple Whale, Varos, 2026).
profit.scen_intro: The same plan, six different average order sizes. Cheaper items sell to more people and get more repeat orders. Expensive items sell to fewer people but each sale is worth more.
profit.rep_b: Why repeat customers matter so much:
profit.rep_p: a customer who comes back costs nothing in ads, so almost all of that sale is profit. We build websites that bring buyers back: customer accounts, wishlists, order tracking, saved addresses, one-tap reorder, offers for returning buyers and reminder messages.
